submission.notes:
Build 62 improves Home loading, binder account isolation and search pagination, and adds Coming soon notices for Gem Pack Vol.7 and Delta Reign.

Please check Home after a cold launch, returning to the app and refreshing; binder edits and switching accounts; multilingual search and loading more results; artwork, Showcase lighting and haptics; and recovery after going offline.

Known limitations: pricing can remain partial, estimated or stale. Some artwork and translations remain unavailable. Catalogue-wide daily movers and printing-specific foil materials are not activated in this release.
